rules.name: ouat178-wp-greeks-check
rules.sql: SELECT current_database() AS db_name, current_user AS db_user, now() AS db_time

SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_delta_2, settle_gamma_11, settle_gamma_12, settle_gamma_21, settle_gamma_22, settle_vega_1, settle_vega_2, settle_theta, settle_chi, settle_curr_exp, created_timestamp AS written_utc FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :vd AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' ORDER BY security_id

SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :vd AND security_id IN ('CM WP H27.H27 CM WP H27.H27 P 106 CS', 'CM WP K27.K27 CM WP K27.K27 P 125 CS')

SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM (VALUES ('CM WP H27.H27 CM WP H27.H27 P 106 CS', 6.68816207019928, -0.488944769443197, 0.526707512320769, -0.0356898186490068), ('CM WP K27.K27 CM WP K27.K27 P 125 CS', 5.54098992103138, -0.543127561469289, 0.434723605117901, -0.0541461679080663) ) AS t(security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_vega_1, settle_theta)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE business_unit = 'CFS') AS mapping_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.underlying_price_table_wp WHERE business_unit = 'CFS') AS price_wp_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.settlement_price_table_wp WHERE business_unit = 'CFS') AS ratio_wp_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_scicom_correlation_input WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND correl_12 IS NOT NULL) AS correl_not_null_rows, (SELECT max(correl_12) FROM opera.recon_scicom_correlation_input WHERE business_unit = 'CFS') AS correl_12

SELECT 'clone' AS src, c.vol1_id, c.vol2_id, c.maturity_date, c.updated_timestamp AS changed_local, (SELECT min(v.expiry_date) FROM opera.vol_id_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.vol_id IN (replace(c.vol1_id, 'WP', 'QW'), replace(c.vol2_id, 'WP', 'SB'))) AS vol_expiry_used FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.security_id = 'CM WP K27.K27 CM WP K27.K27 P 125 CS'

expect.reason: three WP securities in the settlement table
live spreads must have a non-zero price
UAT matches the legacy benchmark within tolerance
